cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
import json, time
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]]}]
req = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"

def chk(label, doc, expect_error=True):
    t=time.time(); o,rc,err = run(doc)
    got = 'error' in o
    ok = (got == expect_error)
    print(('OK  ' if ok else 'BAD '), label, '->', 'error' if got else 'accepted', '%.1fs'%(time.time()-t), err.strip()[-200:] if err.strip() else '')
    return o

# request budget: 20000 fine, 20001 error
chk('20000 requests', base(cases=[case('a',H)], channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":'{{ %r * 20000 }}' % req}]}]), expect_error=False)
chk('20001 requests', base(cases=[case('a',H)], channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":'{{ %r * 20001 }}' % req}]}), expect_error=True)
# chunk line budget: 40000 lines ok, 40001 error
chunk = "POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
one = '{{ %r + b"1\\r\\nz\\r\\n" * %d + b"0\\r\\n\\r\\n" }}'
chk('40000 chunk lines', base(cases=[case('a',H,method='POST')], channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":one % (chunk, 39999)}]}]), expect_error=False)
chk('40001 chunk lines', base(cases=[case('a',H,method='POST')], channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":one % (chunk, 40000)}]}]), expect_error=True)
EOF
